name: Diverse Income Trust plc
tagline: A multi-cap UK equity income trust seeking attractive yields and sustainable dividend growth
hero_kpi_rationale: En tant que trust d'investissement de revenus diversifiés, le rendement en dividendes est le KPI distinctif principal. Contrairement aux sociétés technologiques, ce véhicule d'investissement n'a pas d'activité opérationnelle directe ni de KPI sectoriels tech. Le rendement en dividendes et la croissance des dividendes reflètent sa proposition de valeur fondamentale et sa stratégie multi-capitalisations axée sur le revenu.

kpis.explanation: Annual dividend per share divided by share price, representing the income return to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Core metric for income-focused investment trust strategy.
kpis.description: Diverse Income Trust targets attractive yields through a multi-cap UK equity portfolio, with emphasis on stocks paying good and growing dividends. This is the primary value proposition of the trust.

kpis.explanation: Year-over-year growth rate of dividends paid to shareholders.
kpis.signal: Key differentiator of multi-cap income strategy versus peer group.
kpis.description: The trust's strategy explicitly targets dividend growth faster than most peers. Revenue per share expansion is expected to drive premium share price appreciation and outperformance versus comparable trusts.

kpis.explanation: Total number of individual equity positions in the investment trust portfolio.
kpis.signal: Wide diversification across multi-cap universe reduces concentration risk.
kpis.description: Multi-cap strategy provides genuine diversification across large, mid, and small-cap UK equities, with exposure across 20+ holdings shown. Sector breakdown includes Financials (31.2%), Materials (13.2%), Industrials (12.9%), and Energy (9.3%), with smaller positions in Technology (4.6%).

ai_positioning.summary: The company makes no mention of artificial intelligence strategy, technology, or investments. As a passive investment trust managed by Premier Miton with a focus on UK equity income, it has no active AI positioning.
evidence: No mention of AI in provided documents.
No references to AI-related technology company investments.
Portfolio strategy focused on dividend income and UK multi-cap equities, not innovation or technology disruption.
Information Technology sector represents only 4.6% of portfolio allocation as of February 2023.
